Name: Pokemon Farfetch'd replaces Duck
Author: General_Durandal
Description:
Duck Becomes Farfetch'd!

This mod replaces the Duck.xnb located in the Content/Animals folder in the game directory.
So back it up if you want to bring back the normal Duck.
